supported_claims: A two-family outcome-free EEG trajectory-geometry partition was discovered in the Discovery split under prespecified unsupervised procedures.
The fixed two-family geometry transferred without centroid refitting, threshold tuning, feature selection, or family renaming to the Validation split.
The same fixed geometry transferred again to the Confirmation split among participants meeting the pre-prespecified minimum trajectory criterion.
The structural result therefore replicated across three pre-specified non-overlapping splits of this dataset.
Discovery post-hoc H1-H6 semantic mappings were all unsupported after the prespecified multiplicity gate.
not_supported_claims: Family 1 or Family 2 is a pleasure, pain, valence, liking, emotion, context, category, stimulus, or causal state.
The two families are a universal cross-person biomarker.
The result is an independent external-study replication; all three cohorts come from one dataset split.
The absence of supported Discovery semantic mappings proves that no semantic relation exists.
Validation or Confirmation semantically validate H1-H6; those mappings were intentionally not tested there.
A stable shared discrete taxonomy of local within-person states was found; that branch did not pass its prespecified no-force criteria.
